title: festuca rubra subsp. oelandica
intro: Festuca rubra subsp. oelandica, commonly known as Oland ryegrass, is a subspecies of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation, making it a potential natural remedy for gastrointestinal problems. The therapeutic actions of Oland ryegrass include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Oland ryegrass include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
